name: Competent fixed-factor accounting worksheet rules baseline v1
timing_disclosure: Authored after viewing the frozen cases and first target/simple-baseline run summary. This baseline is not blinded or pre-registered before case design. Cases remain unchanged.
design: Pin all official-factor fields to the same reviewed fixture, refusing edits, analogous to a protected worksheet factor cell and cited metadata.
Require explicit synthetic source status, nonempty activity/site/meter identifiers, matching ZA country, finite nonnegative energy and recognized kWh/MWh units.
Require valid end-exclusive ISO dates within calendar2024; positive interval length.
Reject duplicate activity identifiers and overlapping periods for identical site/meter keys, permit adjacency and distinct keys.
Use Decimal arithmetic to normalize energy and multiply the fixed factor; return total only if all input rows pass.
claim_limit: Transparent independently coded rules reference, not a commercial spreadsheet product, field audit, certified baseline or evidence of GRIDSHIFT market superiority. No target internals or existing target tests read.
